answer: Reputation decay with renewal: voting weight equals an agent's live score, falling 10% per epoch without fresh work. First, the registry records scores on-chain. Second, an agent keeps weight only by finishing one audited task per epoch; two peers sign it, and a failed audit zeroes the score. Third, scores below 50 lose voting rights, so clones fade. Public scores act as a mirror, exposing stale identities draining like an ocean tide. Reaching 100 points needs ten tasks at 0.05 tokens each, so 100 sybils cost 50 tokens and 1,000 audited tasks. Like a garden, reputation withers untended.
